push.title: L 4-7 vs DZ Yanited | You: 9.8 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Well, saddle up and ride, PhogsToffees. A 9.8 is your best match performance of the season.

THE GOOD
+ 90% passing on 31 attempts. Every ball arrived like it had a GPS.
+ 5 shots at DZ Yanited's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Every key pass is a love letter to a teammate.
+ Match rating 9.8, up from your usual 7.7. If the rest of the night was a storm, that was the lighthouse.
+ You set it up, buddskees knocked it down. Repeat as needed.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 5 on target. Keep this in your pocket: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide. Fix it and forget it.
- Same finishing trouble for you and BellyTb1. Buddy up: square it when the keeper commits.
- 2 tackles won cost 0.2. That's on the to-do list.
- That loss cost us one of our chances in Division 3. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.
- Beaten 4-7 by DZ Yanited. Let's use it.

Work on: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound.

Remember, PhogsToffees: Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

That's how legends start. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 4-7 vs DZ Yanited | You: 8.8 (5th best match performance of the season)
push.body:
An 8.8, buddskees, your 5th best match performance of the season. Steady hands.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at DZ Yanited's goal. You got into shooting spots again and again.
+ 2 key passes. That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ That's a partnership I'd build a team around: you and PhogsToffees.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ 7 goals conceded was good for +0.3. That's efficient.

THE BAD
- 2 of 5 shots on target. Little homework: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. Patience, partner.
- 71% passing (20 of 28, down from your usual 80%). Training homework: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- Funny how forcing passes snagged you and BellyTb1 both. Remedy: give each other short options.
- 1 tackle won shaved 0.1 off. Clean that up and you're flying.
- That loss cost us one of our chances in Division 3. We win together and we wear this together.

Fundamentals drill: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Hey, buddskees. You're not behind; you're just early to your comeback.

Keep your head up and your feet moving. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 4-7 vs DZ Yanited | You: 7.3
push.body:
A 7.3, BellyTb1. That's a sturdy front porch of a performance. We can build a house on it.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at DZ Yanited's goal. You weren't shy, and shy doesn't score.
+ buddskees scored and you were the reason. Take a bow.
+ Tackles attempted 6, up from your usual 3. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.
+ 7 goals conceded gave you a +0.3 lift. Nice little tailwind.
+ 1 key pass earned +0.1. That's interest on hard work.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 4 on target. Small change, big gain: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
- 67% passing (12 of 18, down from your usual 75%). Bread and butter: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 7.3. Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.
- Missed tackles 5, up from your usual 2. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- finishing hit you and PhogsToffees both. Partner drill: square it when the keeper commits.

Homework: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

The comeback starts now. - Coach Lasso
